Haa-Meem .
qasam hai iss kitab ki jo haq ko wazeh kernay wali hai .
kay hum ney issay aik mubarak raat mein utaara hai ,   ( kiyonkay ) hum logon  ko khabrdar kernay walay thay ,
issi raat mein her hakeemana moamla humaray hukum say tey kiya jata hai
. ( neez ) hum aik payghumber bhejney walay thay ,
takay tumharay rab ki taraf say rehmat ka moamla ho yaqeenan wohi hai jo her baat sunney wala , her cheez janney wala hai
jo saray aasmano aur zameen ka aur unn kay darmiyan her cheez ka rab hai , agar tum waqaee yaqeen kernay walay ho .
uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , woh zindagi bhi deta hai , aur moat bhi . woh tumhara bhi rab hai , aur tumharay pehlay guzray huye baap dadon ka bhi rab .
. ( phir bhi kafir emaan nahi latay ) balkay woh shak mein parray huye khel ker rahey hain .
lehaza uss din ka intizar kero jab aasman aik wazeh dhuwan ley ker namoodaar hoga .
jo logon  per chah jaye ga .   yeh aik dardnak saza hai .
. ( uss waqt yeh log kahen gay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say yeh azab door ker-dijiye , hum zaroor emaan ley ayen gay .
inn ko naseehat kahan hoti hai ? halankay inn kay paas aisa payghumber aaya hai jiss ney haqeeqat ko khol ker rakh diya hai .
phir bhi yeh log uss say mun morray rahey , aur kehney lagay kay :  yeh sikhaya parhaya huwa hai , deewana hai .
. ( acha ) hum azab ko kuch arsay tak hata detay hain , yaqeen hai kay tum phir ussi halat per loat aao gay .
jiss din humari taraf say sabb say bari pakar hogi , uss din hum poora intiqam ley len gay .
aur inn say pehlay hum ney firon ki qoam ko aazmaya tha , aur unn kay paas aik moaziz payghumber aaye thay .
. ( aur unhon ney kaha tha ) kay :  Allah kay bandon ko meray hawalay kerdo ,   mein tumhari taraf aik amanat daar payghumber ban ker aaya hun
aur yeh kay :  Allah kay aagay sarkashi matt kero , mein tumharay paas aik khuli hoi daleel paish kerta hun ,
aur mein iss baat say apney perwerdigar aur tumharay perwerdigar ki panah leta hun kay tum mujhay sangsaar kero .
aur agar tum mujh per emaan nahi latay to mujh say alag hojao .
phir unhon ney apney perwerdigar ko pukara kay yeh mujrim log hain .
. ( Allah taalaa ney farmaya kay : )  acha tum meray bandon ko ley ker raaton raat rawana hojao . tumhara peecha zaroor kiya jaye ga ,
aur tum samandar ko thehra huwa chorr dena ,   yaqeenan yeh lashkar duboya jaye ga .
kitney baaghaat aur chashmay thay jo yeh log chorr gaye ,
aur kitney khet aur shandaar makanaat ,
aur aesh kay kitney saman jinn mein woh mazay ker rahey thay !
unn ka anjam issi tarah huwa , aur hum ney unn sabb cheezon ka waris aik doosri qoam ko bana diya .
phir naa unn per aasman roya naa zameen , aur naa unn ko kuch mohlat di gaee .
aur bani Israel ko hum ney zillat kay azab say nijat dey di ,
yani firon say . haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara sarkash , hadd say guzray huye logon  mein say tha .
aur hum ney unn ko apney ilm kay mutabiq duniya jahan walon per foqiyat di ,
aur unn ko aesi nishaniyan den jinn mein khula huwa inaam tha .
yeh log saaf kehtay hain
kay :  aur kuch nahi hai , bus humari wohi pehli moat hogi , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jaye ga .
agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko utha lao .
bhala yeh log behtar hain ya tabaa ki qoam   aur woh log jo inn say pehlay thay-? hum ney unn sabb ko halak kerdiya , ( kiyonkay ) woh yaqeeni tor per mujrim log thay .
aur hum ney aasmano aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen bey faeeda khel kernay kay liye peda nahi kerdi hain .
hum ney unhen bar-haq maqsad hi kay liye peda kiya hai ,   lekin inn mein say aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay faislay ka din inn sabb ki muqarrara miyaad hai ,
jiss din koi himayati kissi himayati kay zara bhi kaam nahi aaye ga , aur unn mein say kissi ki koi madad nahi ki jaye gi ,
siwaye uss kay jiss per Allah reham farmaye . yaqeenan woh mukammal iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , boht meharban bhi .
yaqeen jano kay zaqoom ka darkht
gunehgaar ka khana hoga ,
tel ki talchat jaisa . woh logon  kay pet mein iss tarah josh maaray ga
jaisay kholta huwa paani .
. ( farishton say kaha jaye ga : )  iss ko pakro , aur ghaseet ker dozakh kay beechon beech tak ley jao ,
phir uss kay sar kay oopper kholtay huye paani ka azab undel do .
. ( kaha jaye ga kay : )  ley chakh . tu hi hai woh bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara izzat wala !
yeh wohi cheez hai jiss kay baaray mein tum log shak kiya kertay thay .
. ( doosri taraf ) perhezgar log yaqeenan aman o aman wali jagah mein hon gay ,
baaghaat mein aur chashmon mein !
woh aamney samney bethay huye sundus aur istabraq ka libas pehnay hon gay .
unn kay sath yehi moamla hoga , aur hum bari bari aankhon wali huroon ka unn say biyah kerden gay .
woh wahan baray itminan say her qisam kay meway mangwatay hon gay .
jo moat unn ko pehle aa-chuki thi , uss kay ilawa wahan woh kissi aur moat ka maza nahi chaken gay , aur Allah unhen dozakh kay azab say mehfooz rakhay ga ,
yeh sabb tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say fazal hoga . ( insan kay liye ) zabardast kamiyabi yehi hai .
gharz ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko tumhari zaban mein aasaan bana diya hai , takay log naseehat hasil keren .
abb tum bhi intizar kero , yeh log bhi intizar ker rahey hain .
